buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to

minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ATC 1. Scope of Work The contractor shall undertake complete supply, installation, fabrication, fitting, wiring, commissioning and finishing of gypsum false ceiling covering approximately 1,200 sq. ft., including all associated materials, ac cessories, framework, electrical fittings and partitioning work. The work shall be executed on a complete turnkey basis. All materials, labour, tools, equipment, transport ation and incidental expenses shall be included in the quoted rates. 2. Strict Completion Timeline (a) The work is of an urgent nature and shall be completed in all respects within 03 to 04 calendar days (m aximum 96 hours) from the date and time of placement of the Supply/Work Order. (b) The stipulated period shall include: Submission and inspection of all materials and samples. Approval of materials by the consignee. Installation of supporting framework and gypsum boards. Electrical wiring and installation of LED lights. Associated PVC/channel partitioning work. Finishing, testing, commissioning and final handover. (c) The contractor shall mobilise adequate manpower and resources immediately after placement of the or der to meet the stipulated timeline. (d) No extension shall be permissible without prior written approval of the competent authority. Delays sha ll attract action under applicable GeM contract conditions, including liquidated damages wherever admissi ble. 3. Quality and Specifications of Gypsum Boards (a) Gypsum boards shall be of reputed make, premium quality and conform to applicable BIS/IS standards, wherever prescribed. (b) Gypsum boards shall be 12.5 mm thick, fire-resistant (FR) grade. Ordinary gypsum boards shall not be accepted. (c) The contractor shall submit the manufacturer's technical datasheet and relevant fire resistance test cer tificate for verification. (d) Boards shall be free from cracks, warping, moisture damage and manufacturing defects. (e) The approved make and specifications shall not be changed without prior written approval. 4. Inspection and Approval of Materials Before Commencement (a) All materials proposed to be utilised shall be brought to the site and submitted for physical inspection b efore commencement of installation. (b) The materials shall include: 12.5 mm fire-resistant gypsum boards.

GI framework, channels and supporting sections. Screws, fasteners, jointing tape and jointing compound. Electrical wires, conduits and accessories. LED cubical/panel lights. PVC panels/sheets and supporting framework. All other fittings and consumables. (c) The contractor shall submit representative samples, manufacturer's specifications, technical datasheet s and relevant certificates. (d) No installation or execution of work shall commence until all materials and samples have been physical ly inspected and approved by the authorised representative of the consignee. (e) Any material found substandard, damaged or non-compliant shall be rejected and replaced at the contr actor's cost without affecting the stipulated completion timeline. 5. GI Framework and Supporting Structure (a) The false ceiling shall be supported by a good-quality galvanised iron (GI) framework of adequate thick ness and strength. (b) The framework, channel spacing, suspension system and fixing arrangements shall conform to the appr oved manufacturer's installation specifications and tested ceiling system. (c) The contractor shall ensure adequate structural stability, proper alignment and load-bearing capacity. (d) Sagging, uneven surfaces, loose framework or improper fixing shall not be accepted. 6. LED Lighting and Electrical Work (a) Approximately 16 Nos. of good-quality LED cubical/panel lights shall be supplied and fitted in the false ceiling to ensure adequate and uniform illumination. (b) Each LED fitting shall preferably be of 18W/24W capacity, subject to site requirements and approval of the consignee. (c) LED lights shall have a colour temperature of 4000K or 6500K, as approved by the consignee. (d) Lights shall be of reputed make, energy-efficient and suitable for ceiling installation. (e) Complete electrical wiring, conduiting, connections, accessories and necessary fittings shall be include d in the quoted price. (f) All wiring shall be concealed, properly secured and routed through suitable conduits. Loose or exposed wiring shall not be permitted. (g) Proper electrical safety, load distribution and earthing wherever required shall be ensured. (h) All 16 LED lights shall be tested and demonstrated in working condition before final acceptance. 7. Ceiling Height and Associated Partitioning Work (a) The existing ceiling height of the building is approximately 15 feet. (b) The gypsum false ceiling shall be installed at a uniform height of approximately 10 feet from the finished floor level in the designated portion of the building. (c) Approximately half of the building shall be utilised for false ceiling work, while the remaining rear portio n shall continue to be utilised as a bulk storage area without the proposed false ceiling. (d) The exposed vertical gap between the proposed false ceiling level (10 feet) and the existing roof/ceiling level (15 feet), wherever required at the interface between the two areas, shall be properly closed and fini shed. (e) The closure/partition shall be constructed using suitable supporting framework, GI channels and good-q

uality PVC panels/sheets or other approved partition material. (f) The partition shall be structurally stable, properly aligned, securely fixed and aesthetically finished. No open gaps, loose fittings or unfinished edges shall be permitted. (g) All framework, fixing accessories, materials and labour required for this work shall be included in the q uoted price. 8. Installation and Workmanship (a) The ceiling shall be level, properly aligned and free from sagging, undulations and visible imperfections . (b) All joints shall be treated with suitable jointing tape and compound and finished smoothly. (c) All cutting, drilling, fixing, finishing and associated electrical/civil work shall be included in the contract or's scope. (d) The existing building structure, electrical installations and other infrastructure shall not be damaged du ring execution. 9. Testing, Commissioning and Final Acceptance (a) Complete testing and commissioning of the installed ceiling and electrical fittings shall be carried out b y the contractor. (b) The work shall be considered complete only after: Installation of all approved materials. Completion of ceiling and partitioning work. Successful testing of all electrical wiring and LED lights. Proper finishing and cleaning of the work area. Satisfactory inspection by the consignee/authorised representative. (c) All defects and deficiencies observed during inspection shall be rectified immediately at no additional c ost. (d) Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection and certification by the consignee. 10. Cost and Additional Charges The quoted amount shall be inclusive of all materials, transportation, labour, installation, electrical wiring, LED fittings, framework, partitioning, finishing, testing, commissioning and incidental expenses. No additional payment shall be admissible on account of labour, transportation, consumables, installation or any other associated activity. 11. Warranty and Defect Liability (a) The contractor shall provide a minimum 12-month warranty against manufacturing defects and installa tion/workmanship defects, without prejudice to any longer OEM warranty. (b) Any defect arising during the warranty period shall be rectified at the contractor's own cost. (c) Relevant warranty documents for LED lights and electrical fittings shall be provided wherever applicabl e. 12. Safety and Cleanliness (a) The contractor shall ensure adequate safety precautions during execution, particularly while working at height and undertaking electrical installations. (b) All necessary safety equipment shall be arranged by the contractor. (c) All debris, discarded material, packaging and waste generated during execution shall be removed by th e contractor.

(d) The premises shall be handed over in a clean and usable condition. 13. Compliance and Enforcement (a) The contractor shall strictly adhere to all specifications, approved samples, quality requirements and ti melines stipulated in this ATC. (b) No deviation in make, quality, specifications or scope of work shall be permitted without prior written a pproval. (c) In case of failure to meet stipulated requirements, the consignee reserves the right to reject the work, withhold acceptance and initiate appropriate action under applicable GeM contract conditions. (d) The contractor shall be deemed to have inspected the site and understood the complete scope of work before commencement. Note: The contractor shall not be entitled to claim additional charges on account of non-familiarity with sit e conditions, dimensions or execution requirements. .
